rows.text: The Interastral Entertainment Network brought a trendy new wave of entertainment to Planarcadia, much to the distaste of many Fools at the tavern. By blasting it with trashy short videos and relentless gaslighting every day, a Masked Fool named Empath finally nurtured a "Terminal Guard" plant. Fueled by a hatred for online chaos, every one of its leaves can purify over 1 Tbps of data, automatically blocking objectionable content on terminals. Following the successful experiment, Empath placed these plants in restrooms all over Planarcadia, only to find them swiftly removed by other people, since virtually all internet content was deemed "objectionable" by the Guard. More importantly, with such powerful blocking features, it really didn't look like a plant anymore.
